items.title: Many modern techniques were updated at the first Northern Vietnam Interventional Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Conference in 2026. - Vietnam.vn
items.summary: ### On July 25th, the Vietnam Society of Interventional Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, in collaboration with Hung Thinh General Hospital, organized the first Northern Vietnam Interventional Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Conference in 2026. Dr. Nguyen Cong Long - Director of the Gastroenterology and Hepatology Center, Bach Mai Hospital, President of the Vietnam Society of Interventional Gastrointestinal Endoscopy; representatives from the Ministry of Interior; leaders of the Lao Cai Department of Health; leaders of the Sa Pa Ward People's Committee, along with leading experts in gastrointestinal endoscopy and a large number of doctors and medical professionals from many provinces and cities in Vietnam and internationally. Dr. Nguyen Cong Long - President of the Vietnam Society of Interventional Gastrointestinal Endoscopy - emphasized that the conference is an important forum for experts, scientists, and researchers to exchange and share knowledge and experience in the field of interventional gastrointestinal endoscopy.

items.title: NASA to Showcase Agency’s Newest Wind Tunnel in Virginia - NASA (.gov)
items.summary: ### NASA Study Finds Near-Earth Asteroid Is Actually Comet. * A to Z List of Missions. ### The Solar System. ### The Universe. * The Search for Life in the Universe. ### New NASA Earth Missions Gear Up to Start Science Flights. ### NASA’s Juno Takes Temperature of Jupiter’s Fiery Moon Io. article  3 hours ago 2 min read. Media are invited to NASA’s Langley Research Center in Hampton, Virginia, on Friday, July 31, to attend a media tour and ribbon-cutting ceremony for the Flight Dynamics Research Facility, the agency’s first new wind tunnel in more than 40 years. The wind tunnel opening marks a major milestone in the evolution of NASA and the nation’s aeronautics and space research capabilities. The state-of-the-art facility will support research and technology development that will advance NASA’s aeronautics, exploration, and science goals, including establishing a sustained human presence on the lunar surface through the Artemis program and the development of a Moon Base.

items.title: A sailor dies after a Ukraine-bound tanker catches fire off Romania as officials probe war link - AP News
items.summary: An image released by ISU Tulcea, Romanian Inspectorate for Emergency Situations, shows a rescue ship evacuating injured crew members approaching the port in Tulcea, Romania, Tuesday, July 21, 2026, after an LPG tanker ship sailing across the Black Sea toward a Ukrainian port caught fire off the coast of Romania last night, an incident Romania’s president said was “most likely” related to Russia’s war in Ukraine. An image released by ISU Tulcea, Romanian Inspectorate for Emergency Situations, shows rescuers and paramedics attending to an injured crew member in Tulcea, Romania, Tuesday, July 21, 2026, after an LPG tanker ship sailing across the Black Sea toward a Ukrainian port caught fire off the coast of Romania last night, an incident Romania’s president said was “most likely” related to Russia’s war in Ukraine.
